# Manage README translations

`use_multilanguage_readme()` creates translation placeholders below
`inst/translations/` and prints Markdown badges that link to them.

```{r}
#| label = "use_multilanguage_readme",
#| eval = FALSE
use_multilanguage_readme(path = dir)
```

This will help you plan a good structure for multilingual README files.

# Badge management

## Insert badge strings into README

`badge_to_readme()` inserts one Markdown badge into the block delimited by
`<!-- badges: start -->` and `<!-- badges: end -->`. When both README files
exist, it updates `README.Rmd` rather than the generated `README.md`.

Usually you can adds a badge generated by `badger` + `badge_to_readme()`

```{r}
#| label = "badge_to_readme",
#| eval = FALSE
badger::badge_code_size() |>
  badge_to_readme()
```

A badge may also be supplied directly as a single Markdown string:

```{r}
#| label = "badge_to_readme_string",
#| eval = FALSE
badge_to_readme(
  "[![R-CMD-check](https://example.com/check.svg)](https://example.com)",
  path = dir
)
readLines("README.md") |> cli::cli_code()
```

If the exact badge is already present, the function leaves the file unchanged.

## Badge for AI-translated README files

`badge_translated_by_ai()` prints a badge and disclosure statement for
AI-translated README files.

```{r}
#| label = "badge_translated_by_ai"
badge_translated_by_ai("es")
```

# Enrich Rmd YAML headers

`optimize_rmd_yaml()` rewrites the YAML header of one `README.Rmd` or vignette
from the package `DESCRIPTION`: `title`, `subtitle`, `author`, `date`, `lang`,
an enriched `output` block and, for vignettes, the `VignetteIndexEntry`.

Fields that still hold their `usethis` default value (an `"Untitled"` title, a
bare `output: rmarkdown::html_vignette`) are replaced, fields you have changed
are kept, and your `output` options are merged on top of the enriched defaults.

```{r}
#| label = "optimize_rmd_yaml",
#| eval = FALSE
optimize_rmd_yaml() # active RStudio document
optimize_rmd_yaml("vignettes/intro.Rmd")
optimize_rmd_yaml("README.Rmd", readme_format = "github_document")
```

`package_optimize_rmd_yaml()` applies the same logic to `README.Rmd` and every
`.Rmd` below `vignettes/`:

```{r}
#| label = "package_optimize_rmd_yaml",
#| eval = FALSE
package_optimize_rmd_yaml(path = dir)
```

Both functions accept `extra`, `extra_readme` and `extra_vignette` to add your
own fields (merged recursively, later values win) and to drop a built-in
default with `NULL`. `date = "desc"` reuses the `DESCRIPTION` date instead of
`Sys.Date()`:

```{r}
#| label = "package_optimize_rmd_yaml_extra",
#| eval = FALSE
package_optimize_rmd_yaml(
  path = dir,
  date = "desc",
  extra = list(lang = "zh-CN"),
  extra_readme = list(always_allow_html = NULL),
  extra_vignette = list(bibliography = "refs.bib", `link-citations` = TRUE)
)
```

Each function returns invisibly whether (or which files) it changed, so it is
safe to run on every build.
